# ljg-paper Markdown compatibility fixture

Derived from `skills/ljg-paper/scripts/validate_note.test.ts` at pinned upstream commit `dae8ba8e8f513ac1be0697c3a8495b8894c82278` (MIT; see `skills/ljg-paper/LICENSE`). This is synthetic upstream test content, not a claim about an actual paper or a real independent review.

Changes: Org metadata is valid, quoted scalar YAML; `filetags` maps to Markdown `tags`; headings use `#`. The map uses supported version 3 roles and includes the required supplementary-comparison field. Research narrative and exact Chinese note anchors are unchanged. The bundled unmodified upstream validator must accept this pair through the platform syntax projection; negative mutations must still fail.
